reviews.rationale: The result is the object to be printed. Its discourse reference to an extracted collection member is separate from its current object relation; moving it after the finite verb preserves that relation.

reviews.clause: मुद्र् + णिच् + लोट् + सिप् फल + अम्
reviews.rationale: The scaled result is the object of printing, despite its postverbal position. This review certifies the printing clause only; it does not certify the earlier scaling expression or the computed numeric value.

reviews.clause: द्वि + औट् तद् + ङे दा + लोट् + सिप्
reviews.rationale: The value two is the object given, and tad denotes its intended recipient. The written object mediates the 1.4.32 recipient relation; resolving the pronoun's runtime referent is separate from identifying that role. These permutations retain both relations.

reviews.clause: एक + सुँ सूची + ङि असँ + लट् + तिप्
reviews.rationale: One is the principal participant in the existence predicate; the list is its locus. Kartari verbal expression gives nominative under 2.3.46, while the unexpressed locus takes locative under 2.3.36. The selected orders preserve this existential reading.

reviews.clause: फल + अम् सूची + ङि स्था + णिच् + लोट् + सिप्
reviews.rationale: The result is what is placed and the list is the locus of placement. They have distinct object and locus designations; a preceding collection operation does not turn the locative into another object.

reviews.clause: एक + अम् द्वि + औट् च युज् + णिच् + लोट् + सिप्
reviews.rationale: The two coordinated values are the objects to be combined; each has karman designation under 1.4.49 and unexpressed-object accusative under 2.3.2. The differing number slots do not change that relation.

reviews.clause: राम + अम् सीता + अम् च सम् + ग्रहँ + श्ना + लोट् + सिप्
reviews.rationale: Rama and Sita are what is gathered, independently of their animacy. Both are coordinated karmans, with 1.4.49 followed by 2.3.2.

reviews.clause: मुद्र् + णिच् + लोट् + सिप् फल + अम्
reviews.rationale: The result is the object of printing. Its postverbal position does not change the 1.4.49 to 2.3.2 chain.

reviews.clause: प्रथम + अम् द्वितीय + अम् च युज् + णिच् + लोट् + सिप्
reviews.rationale: The substantivized ordinal references denote the two operands being combined. They are objects within the procedure body, not arguments of its declaration header.
